objective: Permit vLLM's explicit metadata-free profile phase while retaining R100's live request-metadata selection for inference.

treatment.profile_only: When forward_context.attn_metadata is exactly None, execute the R99 single-request arm and emit a distinct profile-fallback log.
treatment.live_inference: Require the layer key and GDNAttentionMetadata type, compute max(num_prefills, num_decodes, num_spec_decodes), and select R99 for one request or R97 for more than one.
treatment.logging: Emit distinct profile, live-single, and live-multi messages from the selector rather than from the low-level arithmetic helper.
treatment.unchanged: All arithmetic kernels, frozen workload, oracle, and server settings remain R100-identical.

followup_if_pass: Build a non-tracing image and begin the clean-boot varied realistic-prompt qualification before any speed promotion.
followup_if_fail: Preserve the result and identify the exact runtime phase/request count chosen; do not use prompt or tensor-row heuristics.
promotion_boundary: Diagnostic only. No public speed or quality authority; the current boot contains an earlier GPU reset.
